'''Tarkom''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3639 BBY]], Tarkom, along with [[Addy Ingrol]], [[Asirr]], and [[Evad]], assisted Doctor [[Sannus Lorrick]] who was experimenting on the [[rakghoul]] virus in his [[Lost Island|laboratory]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Tarkom and the scientists all believed that Lorrick was searching for a cure on the virus. As four Tionese planets [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|fell]] to the rakghoul virus, Tarkom and the other assistants discovered Lorrick's true plans and attempted to stop him, but they were infected with the virus and placed under his control. He was later killed by a strike team that [[Mission to the Lost Island|came]] to stop Lorrick's self-infection with the virus.
